data.narrative:
Anduril Industries, a Series H defense and security company, commands a current valuation of $61 billion following $11 billion in cumulative fundraising. The valuation universe spans 23 same-sector peers, including 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers such as Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, Quantum-Systems, and Flock Safety.

Peer-median analysis proved inapplicable to this valuation. The narrow filters—same-stage peers, adjacent-stage peers, and similar valuation-tier peers—each yielded fewer than three datapoints, the minimum threshold required for reliable triangulation. While the broader Defense & Security sector contains sufficient public and private comparables, none cluster sufficiently around Anduril's stage and valuation tier to support meaningful median-based benchmarking. Reliance on an all-sector median would obscure material differences in capital deployment, revenue scale, and technology maturity across the defense ecosystem.

No triangulated valuation range can be supported by the available data. The current $61 billion valuation remains unvetted against methodologically sound peer analysis. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficient comparable transactions at Anduril's scale and stage, limiting external anchoring of the valuation. Resolution would require either identification of additional late-stage defense technology peers or deployment of alternative methodologies (discounted cash flow, precedent transaction analysis) using company-specific financial data not present in this dataset.
